definitions.gloss: tap water; municipal water; mains water
definitions.explanation: Water supplied through the public water system to homes and buildings through pipes. Distinguished from well water, spring water, or bottled water.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{水道|すいどう}→水道：01058_suidou⟧ (waterworks; water supply system) and {水|すい} (water). Japan is one of the few countries in the world where tap water is safe to drink directly from the faucet, a fact often mentioned in travel guides and daily conversation. Despite this, many Japanese people prefer bottled water or use water filters.
